limitations: One LLM sample per fixture; the client sends neither temperature nor seed, so runs are not reproducible.
Compilation used pragma-compatible 0.8.x solc versions, not the original fixture compiler settings.
No full stateful differential suite was run; selector mismatch alone prevents drop-in behavioral comparison for compiled candidates.
Compile success is not evidence of semantic correctness.
